name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension / Projected Distinguishing Range (Affine Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine upper bound in terms of the other on finite binary classes. These are unbounded-ratio witnesses with both parameters growing, not bounded-versus-unbounded witnesses. In fact the established size bounds imply $\mathrm{Edim}\le2^{\mathrm R^p}-1$ and $\mathrm R^p\le2^{\mathrm{Edim}}-1$, so functional incomparability is false. These transitive exponential consequences are explained in the survey, not inserted as duplicate direct relationships.
parameter_1_larger_witness: On #classes/triangular_code_separation, Edim is 2^n and $n+1\le\mathrm R^p\le6n+5$. Thus Edim/Rp tends to infinity. The lower bound confirms that the smaller parameter is not bounded on this family.
parameter_2_larger_witness: On #classes/paired_code_separation, projected distinguishing range is 2^n and $n+1\le\mathrm{Edim}\le8n+3$. Thus Rp/Edim tends to infinity. The lower bound confirms that the smaller parameter is not bounded on this family.
proof_source: Full proof in the survey: cor:eluder-range-affine-incomparable, using prop:paired-code-eluder, prop:triangular-code-range and the database-owned endpoint proofs.
